description: Explain why a module is bundled by tracing its import chain from an entry point to the module. moduleSizeBytes is the unminified webpack module size, not emitted chunk size. Requires load_webpack_stats first.

limit.description: Maximum matching modules to trace. Defaults to 10.

moduleName.description: Module or package name to search for (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "lodash"

name: trace_import
title: Trace Import
